steps.message: All 5 tests pass (4 pre-existing + 1 new regression test). Here is the final patch:

## Summary

**Root cause:** In `omniNotes/src/main/java/it/feio/android/omninotes/utils/TagsHelper.java`, `removeTag()` used plain substring replacement:

```java
title = title.replaceAll(tagToRemove.getText(), "");
content = content.replaceAll(tagToRemove.getText(), "");
```

`String.replaceAll` removes *every substring* occurrence of the tag text. So unchecking `#test` in the tag dialog also stripped the `#test` prefix out of `#testa` and `#testb`, leaving the orphan fragments `a` and `b` in the note (matching the report: "it will remove all tags with the same header as the deleted tag").

Two defects were in that one line:
1. The match wasn't anchored to word/token boundaries, so it hit prefixes of longer tags.
2. The tag text was fed to `replaceAll` as a raw regex, so any regex metacharacter in a tag would be interpreted rather than matched literally.

**Fix:** Removal now only matches the tag as a standalone token, and the tag text is quoted so it is always treated literally:

```java
Pattern pattern = Pattern.compile("(^|\\s)" + Pattern.quote(tagText) + "(?=\\s|$)");
return pattern.matcher(text).replaceAll("$1");
```

The leading whitespace is captured and restored via `$1` (rather than consumed) and the trailing separator uses a zero-width lookahead, so adjacent/repeated tags like `#test #test` are both removed correctly and the surrounding text layout is preserved. Using whitespace delimiters rather than `\b` also keeps non-ASCII tags (e.g. `#привет` vs `#приветствие`) working correctly, since Java's `\b` is ASCII-based by default.

**Verification:**
- `./gradlew clean assembleDebug` → **BUILD SUCCESSFUL**
- Validated the removal logic against the reported scenario plus edge cases (tag-only text, repeated tags, newline separators, Cyrillic tags): `#test #testa #testb` → `#testa #testb` retained.
- Added regression test `removesOnlyExactlyMatchingTagsFromNote` to `TagsHelperTest`; all 5 tests pass (`tests="5" failures="0" errors="0"`), including the pre-existing tag add/remove/retrieve tests, confirming existing functionality is preserved.
